rung_purposes.purpose: Interlock and energize HiPot start (Y30) and HV beacon (Y31) while testing conditions are met.
Latch HiPot PASS status (M310) when tester signals pass (X30).
Latch HiPot FAIL status (M311) when tester signals fail (X31).
Reset PASS (M310) and FAIL (M311) flags when pallet leaves ST30 (X33 falling edge).
